title: AID Run Control Protocol Lock
description: Per-run protocol version lock. Set at run init; all artifacts produced in this run inherit the control_protocol value. Wiring into fsm-state.yaml is E2+ (not implemented in E1).
$comment: reference only — describes the run-level lock object; not wired into FSM in E1

control_protocol.$comment: enforced (format) — locked at run init; all artifacts in this run carry this value
control_protocol.description: Protocol version for this run. Once set, cannot change within the run.

policy_version.$comment: reference — semantic version of the policy snapshot used for this run
policy_version.description: Policy version snapshot at run start (e.g., '2.38.0').

locked_at.$comment: reference — ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when control_protocol was locked
locked_at.description: When the run control protocol was locked. ISO-8601 UTC.
